data.content_ref: inline:The 'Critical Conventionalism' of foundation 02361cab... inherits its structural vulnerability from the 'methodological falsificationism' of foundation 088a63..., specifically regarding the psychological stability of scientists; it is REFUTED IF the arbitrary nature of the decree in the former fails to resolve the belief-convention tension identified in the latter, thereby collapsing the distinction between a useful game rule and a groundless fiction.
